_comment: Words used to split publication sections into citations and read their fields (whole words, any case unless noted). journal_words and conference_words set the type from the venue; abbreviations keep their dot optional; 'J.' counts as a journal word only before an abbreviated word or 'of' ('J. Appl. Phys.', 'J. of ...'), so an author initial is never one (set in the code). weak_type_words (Proceedings, Review, Letters, ...) set the type from the venue only when no section heading sets one; the other journal and conference words always do. publisher_words help find the venue but never set the type. conference_cues and other_cues are used only when no sub-heading, section heading or venue word sets the type. subheading_words mark a short heading line inside a publications section (Journal Papers, Conference Proceedings, Book Chapters); it sets the type of the entries under it and is never an entry. author_connectors are lower-case name parts allowed inside an author list. No personal data.
